description: This file contains functions for upgrading and configuring an Asrock device, specifically manipulating the boot configuration by modifying partition data in MTD devices, and preparing the upgrade environment.

methods.name: asrock_bootconfig_mangle
methods.description: Modifies boot configuration data in the device's MTD partition based on the given argument ('bootcheck' or 'sysupgrade'), adjusting specific bytes to set the device's boot mode.

methods.name: asrock_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for upgrade by setting boot flags and removing certain UBI volumes, calling 'asrock_bootconfig_mangle' internally.
